minimum_requirement: Original public-meeting or exercise-media file hash captured before editing.
Camera/recorder/platform source or public source URL recorded.
Capture time with clock source and timezone recorded.
Custody handoff from recorder/platform to evidence custodian.
Transcript method, model/version, or human transcriber recorded.
Speaker identity basis and uncertainty recorded.
Every quote tied to start/end timecodes.
Context window before and after quote preserved.
Cuts, excerpts, captions, normalization, or compression recorded.
C2PA/content credentials or explicit absence recorded.
Deepfake/synthetic-media screen logged as context, not proof.
At least two independent clock/source channels when available.
Corrections/retractions/Q&A contradictions captured.
PII/security-sensitive/raw-evaluator material routed to sensitive annex.
Quote cannot assert passed/ready/closed without AAR/IP and adjudication.
Duplicate public posts from same source cluster counted once.
EXIF/container/hash metadata preserved or absence explained.
A/V sync drift or dub mismatch recorded.
Transcript confidence and ambiguous words flagged.
Translated/subtitled quotes tied to original language.
Any version differences between raw, public, and released media recorded.
Contradictory media, reporter notes, or official corrections routed.
Two-person release board approval before public quotation.
AV/transcript/quote provenance can never close readiness by itself.
